name: Symbols And Similitudes
overview: Scripture reveals profound spiritual truths through symbols and similitudes, such as the trees in Eden representing life and knowledge, where God commanded Adam not to eat from the tree of knowledge to avoid death. The rainbow is established by God as a perpetual token of His covenant with all living creatures, signifying His faithfulness and mercy. These symbols serve as tangible reminders of God's covenantal relationship with humanity and His divine provision.
